interpretation.claim: Twenty-four high-impact root-only names now have explicit local ownership decisions; all remain non-migrating compatibility decisions except four Advanced candidate reviews.
does_not_establish: a complete review of all root-only exports
permission to remove or deprecate root symbols
Stable or Advanced namespace compatibility for future releases

next_actions: Review the remaining root-only queue in similarly bounded batches.
Approve any namespace move only with an explicit compatibility and type-identity plan.
Keep Stable and Advanced facades unchanged until ownership review is complete.

rows.name: DiagnosticReport
rows.rationale: Top-level report container used by all analysis entry points; root identity is part of the current compatibility contract.

rows.name: EntityRef
rows.rationale: Shared report identity type used by multiple subsystems; preserve root identity while the API is pre-1.0.

rows.name: EvaluationCache
rows.rationale: Evaluator cache type is coupled to numerical evaluation lifecycle; defer migration until cache ownership is documented.

rows.name: EvaluationFailure
rows.rationale: Failure record crosses evaluator and report boundaries; retain root compatibility while schemas remain pre-1.0.

rows.name: EvaluationPoint
rows.rationale: Public point type appears in model, numerical, and test contracts; no safe namespace-only migration is established.

rows.name: EvaluationPointProvenance
rows.rationale: Point provenance participates in reproducibility contracts and report schemas; no namespace-only move is safe yet.

rows.name: Evidence
rows.rationale: Evidence record is shared by renderer-neutral reports and tests; do not split ownership without a report-schema review.

rows.name: Finding
rows.rationale: Primary diagnostic record type with broad downstream construction and inspection; compatibility takes precedence over tier cleanup.

rows.name: JacobianEntry
rows.rationale: Sparse derivative entry type is constructed directly by numerical and adapter paths; retain root identity for evaluator compatibility.

rows.name: NumericalEvaluation
rows.rationale: Central evaluator contract used by rank, activity, and adapter paths; no migration without a coordinated type-identity plan.

rows.name: SemanticBlockScalingMap
rows.rationale: Generic scaling-map type is shared by core and adapter reports; retain root identity until the type-tier plan is explicit.

rows.name: bmopf_constraint_semantic_row_map

rows.name: bmopf_diagonal_scaling_map
rows.rationale: BMOPFTools scaling adapter belongs in the research namespace pending a stable semantic contract and compatibility review.

rows.name: bmopf_physical_solver_kkt_report
rows.rationale: BMOPFTools physical-KKT adapter is research-facing and should remain an Advanced candidate until endpoint semantics are stabilized.

rows.name: bmopf_start_completion_point
rows.rationale: BMOPFTools-specific lifecycle helper is a plausible Advanced candidate, but adapter ownership and compatibility still require explicit review.

rows.name: evaluate_numerical
rows.rationale: Core numerical evaluation entry point used across tests and adapters; moving it would create a broad compatibility break.

rows.name: evaluation_point_fingerprint
rows.rationale: Provenance helper is used by reproducibility and cross-check ledgers; retain while artifact schemas remain v1-compatible.

rows.name: finding_code_counts
rows.rationale: Diagnostic aggregation helper is used by benchmark and regression ledgers; preserve its current root entry point.

rows.name: findings
rows.rationale: Report inspection helper used throughout regression assertions; retain as a compatibility surface.

rows.name: incidence_graph
rows.rationale: Structural graph helper is used by analysis and tests; preserve root access while graph API ownership remains broad.

rows.name: ipopt_profile_with_iteration_trace!
rows.rationale: Solver instrumentation entry point is consumed by trace campaigns; defer tier migration until solver-extension ownership is reviewed.

rows.name: report_data
rows.rationale: Renderer-neutral serialization boundary is used by all report families; preserve root compatibility while schemas evolve.

rows.name: snapshot
rows.rationale: Core model-boundary constructor with broad test and benchmark usage; retain until a versioned compatibility plan exists.

rows.name: solver_result_point
rows.rationale: Solver-result provenance boundary is consumed by adapters and tests; retain until solver extension ownership is reviewed.

source.migration_policy: No export is moved, deprecated, or removed by this ledger.
source.selection_policy: Highest repository-usage root-only names plus one BMOPF Advanced candidate; this bounded review does not represent the full queue.
